lines.text: Paul reminds the Corinthians that as pagans they were led astray to mute idols.
Paul says there are different gifts, but the same Spirit, and different ministries, but the same Lord.
Paul lists gifts such as wisdom, knowledge, faith and healing, and says the Spirit gives them as He determines.
Paul says the body is one unit with many parts, and so it is with Moses, and all were baptized into one body.
Paul tells them they are the body of Christ, and God appointed first apostles, second prophets, third pastors.
